contradiction_resolution: SOURCED AND GRANTED FACTS: FND-0105 supplies L≅K_C-D. Schreyer's theorem supplies the tetragonal-scroll complete-intersection description when its scroll hypotheses apply. Bujokas-Patel proves balancedness of the Casnati-Ekedahl bundle for a general cover, but the cited result does not identify CE-balancedness alone with the smooth scroll X_{1,1,1}. The curated packet contains no corroborated implication from F=O(4)+O(5) to that scroll type, and FND-0104 leaves non-primitivity open. DEDUCTION: If Gamma≤D_a+D_b, then R=D_a+D_b-Gamma is effective, deg R=8-6=2, and [R]=2D-L=3D-K_C. On a non-hyperelliptic curve a degree-2 line bundle has at most one section, because two independent sections would produce a g^1_2 after removal of any fixed part. Thus R is unique. Its support forces {a,b} to contain gamma(supp R), yielding the stated empty/finite/at-most-one-dimensional trichotomy. This corroborates the load-bearing residual classification. CONDITIONAL CHECK: On Q=X_{1,1,1}=P(O(1)^3), with C a complete intersection of 2H and 2H-R, twisting the Koszul resolution by 3R-H and applying Leray gives H^0(C,3D-K_C)=0. However, importing this calculation for every CE-balanced fibre requires the unsupported smooth-scroll implication. The finding's claim that non-effectivity is 'the generic situation' therefore remains insufficiently sourced at its stated scope. No curated claim directly contradicts the residual classification, and no equivalent corroborated finding provides a merge target. Because the finding combines a correct exact trichotomy with an unresolved genericity assertion and a stabilizer conclusion conditional on ATT-0083(F), it should remain a candidate rather than be promoted or retired.

scope.conditional_scope: If the canonical tetragonal scroll is the smooth cubic scroll X_{1,1,1} and C is its Schreyer complete intersection of classes 2H and 2H-R, then H^0(C,3D-K_C)=0, so the incidence is empty.
granted: the degree-four cover supplies a base-point-free pencil D
not_audited: ATT-0083 clause (F)'s identification of this incidence with the complete non-trivial-stabilizer locus

scope.proved_scope: Set-theoretically, R is effective of degree 2 with class 3D-K_C=2D-L; h^0(3D-K_C)<=1, so an effective R is unique. The incidence is empty if this class is non-effective, finite if R has two distinct gamma-images, and can have dimension 1 only when R is contained in one gamma-fibre. Intersecting with the reduced-divisor locus can only decrease these dimensions.
unresolved: The curated dependencies do not prove that CE-balancedness F=O(4)+O(5) forces the smooth scroll X_{1,1,1}.
FND-0104 explicitly leaves general non-primitivity unresolved.
The parenthetical assertion that 3D-K_C is non-effective generically is not established by the residual calculation or by the cited balancedness result alone.
